conservative.note: deliberately far below the published Start-tier limits for Claude Sonnet 5.5 (4,000 RPM, 2,000,000 ITPM, 400,000 OTPM): new organisations may be in an Evaluation tier with lower, unpublished limits, and this organisation's tier is not known. The account's actual limits from anthropic-ratelimit-* response headers replace rpm / input_tpm / output_tpm once seen (x safety factor).

headers.anthropic-ratelimit-requests-limit / -re: requests per minute; reset = RFC 3339 time of full replenishment
headers.anthropic-ratelimit-input-tokens-*: input tokens per minute (uncached input + cache-write tokens count; cache reads do not)
headers.anthropic-ratelimit-output-tokens-*: output tokens per minute (actual output tokens; max_tokens does not count)
headers.anthropic-ratelimit-tokens-*: the most restrictive token limit currently in effect
headers.retry-after: seconds; not every 429 carries it (the monthly spend-cap 429 never does)

header_policy: provider limits from headers replace the configured rpm / input_tpm / output_tpm (actual account limits); the limiter is a token bucket on the provider side, a sliding 60 s window locally
spend_limits: monthly spend cap per tier (Start $500, Build $1,000, Scale $200,000); at the cap the API returns 429 with error.details.error_code enforced_spend_limit_reached and no retry-after (run stops, no retry); a user-set spend limit returns 400 'You have reached your specified ...' (run stops)
